method: Relevant independently authored formation sections inspected, alongside Keio’s own report-writing guide. All investigation, handout, figures, commentary, examples and tasks are original fictional classroom material. Earlier-level forms retrieved in advanced reading, not claimed exclusively N1 or an official syllabus.

points.formation: Noun + とは / というのは introduces an explanation or definition. No inserted だ before とは when the term itself is being defined.
points.teachingChoice: The report explicitly supplies a local working definition of reading time. Do not confuse it with sentence-final surprise とは or a universal dictionary definition. Publisher labels vary.

points.form: Proposition + とされる / とされている
points.formation: Plain verb/i-adjective + とされる・とされている; noun/na-adjective + (だ)とされる・とされている.
points.teachingChoice: Explicitly attribute the local class policy, distinct from measured results. The construction alone neither proves the proposition nor provides an adequate citation.

points.form: Noun + に基づいて / に基づき / に基づく / に基づいた
points.formation: Noun + に基づいて・に基づき modifies an action; に基づく・に基づいた modifies a following noun. 基づく is godan.
points.teachingChoice: Name the ten complete paired records as the basis. Do not score をもとに as universally wrong; usage overlaps and depends on context.

points.formation: Plain verb/i-adjective + と考えられる; noun/na-adjective + だと考えられる. Source guide supports separating attribution, evidence and an author’s inference in report prose.
points.teachingChoice: Keep a plausible familiarity explanation smaller than the fixed-order evidence. Neither formal wording nor this phrase guarantees certainty or objectivity; no universal subjective/objective contrast with 思われる is adopted.

sourceCautions: Bunpro’s standalone とは page teaches surprise, not the selected definition, and is not used for that point.
The guessed Nihongobu page returned navigation only; no relevant formation sections were inspectable and it is not relied on.
A J-STAGE PDF could not be reliably opened; it is not represented as inspected evidence.

Twelve adult volunteers, ten complete pairs, 38/26-second medians and seven/eight correct answers are separate fictional quantities. No statistical test, population claim, causal isolation or completed follow-up is implied.
Long technical headwords are met as a reading vocabulary menu; dialogue is not padded to include every headword.
audioScope: Three original thirteen-line scenes at 1.2, existing distinct Violetto cast deliveries; Clear vocabulary and practice audio. Seven new exact speech inputs pin full preflight mora sequences, without changing earlier audio.
